name: pages-data-loading
goal: Page data loading uses a reusable accessible status until the matching history and revision are ready

evidence: Replace plain history/revision status text with one accessible reusable visual loading component; retain until matching data is ready and remove on completion/error.

Existing shell pieces fixture copies static loading text; current browser matrices wait for content and never hold index/revision requests. Extend canonical catalog host browser coverage with delayed requests and lifecycle assertions at three viewports.
